scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const { version } = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); const file = 'dist/cli.js'; const source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); const declaration = /^const VERSION = .*;$/m; if (!declaration.test(source)) throw new Error('CLI version declaration missing'); writeFileSync(file, source.replace(declaration, 'const VERSION = ' + JSON.stringify(version) + ';'));"
